nodes.title: COMMENT
code:
GAME PLAN

END GOAL: build the ULTIMATE SCARECROW so we never see a crow ever again. Scarecrow built = GAME WON!

DONE: grow, water and pluck pumpkins. Rain 1 day in 10 waters for free. Weeds bring crows (10 weeds = 1 crow, max 3) that peck pumpkins to bits - chase them off.

TODO: earn the scarecrow parts with plucked pumpkins (pole, coat, hat, pumpkin head?) and build it in the field.

THE ENDING: walk up to the scarecrow = THE END (gameEnd).
TODO nice end BITMAP - placeholder is the ENDING_SCR PETSCII screen at $3400.
TODO nice end MUSIC - placeholder is the END MUSIC jig.

CHEAT: hold S + C on the field. The scarecrow appears on the far side - walk up to it for the ending.

nodes.title: CROWS
code:
// CROWS
// Every 10 weeds on the field lets one crow come, up to 3 (crow 0 needs 10+
// weeds, crow 1 20+, crow 2 30+). Never in the rain: the crows are hardware
// sprites 2-4, which are raindrops on wet days (rainStart resets them).
// A crow flies in from the right to a random pumpkin that no other crow has
// picked, lands, looks around and pecks - 4 pecks break the pumpkin - then flies
// off to the right. It also flies off the moment its pumpkin is gone (plucked,
// or broken) or the player comes within about 2 cells. After leaving it waits
// 2-4 seconds before it may come again.
// Once the ultimate scarecrow is up (SCARECROW block) no crow comes again:
// crowUpdate hands over to scareUpdate.
// Positions are in half pixels across (x = CROW_X * 2) so they fit a byte.
// The animations are the frame tables at the end of this block (crowFlyL,
// crowFlyR, crowBobT, crowLandT) - Player sprite set slots, pointer $A0 + slot:
//   13-16 fly left   17-20 fly right   21/22 peck   23 look left   24 look right
// States: 0 away (waiting), 1 flying in, 2 on the pumpkin, 3 flying off.
CROW_ST  = $C440   // 3 states (0-3, above)
CROW_X   = $C443   // 3 x / 2
CROW_Y   = $C446   // 3 y
CROW_TX  = $C449   // 3 target x / 2 (where it lands)
CROW_TY  = $C44C   // 3 target y
CROW_T   = $C44F   // 3 timers (state 0: frames until it may come, state 2: pose clock)
CROW_HIT = $C452   // 3 pecks so far on this pumpkin
CROW_REC = $C455   // 3 target PUMPKINS record offset
CROW_ANI = $C458   // 3 animation clocks (+1 every frame)
CROW_FR  = $C45B   // 3 sprite slot being shown
CROW_BIT = $C45E   // 3 sprite bits  $04 $08 $10
CROW_NBT = $C461   // 3 inverted     $FB $F7 $EF
CROW_N   = $C464   // crows allowed now (weeds / 10, max 3)
CROW_I   = $C465   // the crow being worked on (saved X)
CROW_CNT = $C466   // loop counter
CROW_PX  = $C467   // player x / 2 this frame
CROW_PY  = $C468   // player y this frame
WEEDS    = $C469   // weeds counted
CROW_BOB = $C46F   // 3 y offsets from the wing beat (crowBobT)
CROW_TMP = $C472   // record offset being tried by crowTarget

// ---- crowsReset ----  all crows away; each waits before it may come
// (start of every day, and when the rain starts or stops)
crowsReset:
lda #$04          // sprite bit for each crow: crow 0 = sprite 2 ...
sta CROW_BIT
lda #$08
sta CROW_BIT+1
lda #$10          // ... crow 2 = sprite 4
sta CROW_BIT+2
lda #$fb          // and the same bits inverted, for clearing
sta CROW_NBT
lda #$f7
sta CROW_NBT+1
lda #$ef
sta CROW_NBT+2
ldx #$02          // crows 2, 1, 0
crLoop:
lda #$00          // state 0 = away
sta CROW_ST,x
jsr crowWait      // with a fresh wait
dex
bpl crLoop
rts

// ---- crowWait ----  IN X. 100-227 frames (2-4.5 s) before the next try
crowWait:
lda $d41b         // random byte (SID voice 3 noise)
and #$7f          // 0-127
clc
adc #100          // 100-227
sta CROW_T,x
rts

// ---- crowCount ----  CROW_N = weeds / 10, max 3
crowCount:
lda #$00
sta WEEDS
ldy #$00          // 64 records x 4 bytes = the whole page
ccLoop:
lda PUMPKINS,y    // column: $FE free slot, $FF end marker - skip both
cmp #$fe
bcs ccNext
lda PUMPKINS+2,y  // kind: bit 7 set = a weed
bpl ccNext
inc WEEDS
ccNext:
iny               // next record
iny
iny
iny
bne ccLoop        // until Y wraps to 0
lda WEEDS         // divide by 10 by counting subtractions
ldy #$00
ccDiv:
cmp #10
bcc ccSet         // under 10 left - done
sbc #10           // (carry is set here)
iny
cpy #$03          // never more than 3 crows
bne ccDiv
ccSet:
sty CROW_N
rts

// ---- crowTarget ----  IN X. A random pumpkin that no other crow is flying to
// or pecking. Carry set + CROW_REC/TX/TY, carry clear = none free.
// Lands on top of it: x/2 = col*4+10, y = row*8+34 (feet on the pumpkin).
crowTarget:
lda $d41b         // start at a random record (multiple of 4) ...
and #$fc
tay
lda #64           // ... and try all 64 from there
sta CROW_CNT
tgLoop:
lda PUMPKINS,y    // free slot / end marker?
cmp #$fe
bcs tgNext
lda PUMPKINS+2,y  // kind 0 = seed, bit 7 = weed - only pumpkins 1-7
beq tgNext
bmi tgNext
sty CROW_TMP
jsr crowTaken     // another crow already has it?
bcs tgNext
tya               // this one - remember the record
sta CROW_REC,x
lda PUMPKINS,y    // column -> landing x / 2
asl
asl
clc
adc #10
sta CROW_TX,x
lda PUMPKINS+1,y  // row -> landing y
asl
asl
asl
clc
adc #34
sta CROW_TY,x
sec
rts
tgNext:
iny               // next record (wraps round the page)
iny
iny
iny
dec CROW_CNT
bne tgLoop
clc               // nothing free
rts

// ---- crowTaken ----  IN CROW_TMP = record, CROW_I = this crow.
// Carry set if another crow is flying to it or on it. OUT Y = CROW_TMP.
crowTaken:
ldy #$02          // crows 2, 1, 0
tkLoop:
cpy CROW_I        // not this crow
beq tkNext
lda CROW_ST,y     // only state 1 (flying in) or 2 (on the pumpkin) count
cmp #$01
beq tkCheck
cmp #$02
bne tkNext
tkCheck:
lda CROW_REC,y
cmp CROW_TMP
beq tkYes         // same pumpkin - taken
tkNext:
dey
bpl tkLoop
ldy CROW_TMP
clc               // free
rts
tkYes:
ldy CROW_TMP
sec               // taken
rts

// ---- crowGone ----  IN X. Carry set if its pumpkin is no longer there
// (plucked by the player, or the record reused for something else)
crowGone:
ldy CROW_REC,x
lda PUMPKINS,y    // freed slot?
cmp #$fe
bcs cgYes
lda PUMPKINS+2,y  // not a pumpkin any more (seed / weed)?
beq cgYes
bmi cgYes
clc               // still there
rts
cgYes:
sec
rts

// ---- crowNear ----  IN X. Carry set if the player is within ~2 cells
crowNear:
lda CROW_X,x      // |crow x - player x| (half pixels)
sec
sbc CROW_PX
bcs cnAx
eor #$ff          // negative - flip it
adc #$01
cnAx:
cmp #12           // 24 pixels across
bcs cnNo
lda CROW_Y,x      // |crow y - player y|
sec
sbc CROW_PY
bcs cnAy
eor #$ff
adc #$01
cnAy:
cmp #22           // 22 pixels down
bcs cnNo
sec               // close - scared
rts
cnNo:
clc
rts

// ---- crowFlee ----  IN X. Off to the right (state 3)
crowFlee:
lda #$03
sta CROW_ST,x
rts

// ---- crowBreak ----  IN X. The pecked pumpkin is gone - bare dirt in both
// of its cells, record freed
crowBreak:
stx CROW_I        // drawGround uses X
ldy CROW_REC,x
lda PUMPKINS,y    // its column / row for drawGround
sta UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda PUMPKINS+1,y
sta UV_GOT_ROW
lda #$fe          // free the record
sta PUMPKINS,y
lda #$00          // dirt tile, left cell
jsr drawGround
inc UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda #$00          // dirt tile, right cell
jsr drawGround
ldx CROW_I
rts

// ---- crowUpdate ----  every dry frame (from frameFx). Raindrop sprites 5-7
// off, then each crow moves and is drawn on sprite 2 + crow.
crowUpdate:
lda $d015         // sprites 5-7 (the raindrops) off
and #$1f
sta $d015
lda $d010         // player position, x / 2 with the 9th bit: $D010 bit 0
lsr               // into carry ...
lda $d000
ror               // ... and in at the top
sta CROW_PX
lda $d001
sta CROW_PY
lda SCARE_ON      // the ultimate scarecrow is up - no more crows, ever
beq cuCrows
jmp scareUpdate
cuCrows:
ldx #$02          // crows 2, 1, 0
cuLoop:
stx CROW_I
inc CROW_ANI,x    // animation clock
lda CROW_ST,x     // jump to the state's code
bne cuActive
jmp cuWait
cuActive:
cmp #$01
bne cuNot1
jmp cuIn
cuNot1:
cmp #$02
bne cuNot2
jmp cuLand
cuNot2:
jmp cuAway

// state 0 - away. Count down, then come if the weeds allow this crow.
cuWait:
lda CROW_T,x
beq cuTry
dec CROW_T,x
jmp cuHide
cuTry:
jsr crowWait      // next try after another wait, whatever happens now
jsr crowCount
ldx CROW_I
cpx CROW_N        // crow 0 needs 1 allowed, crow 1 needs 2 ...
bcs cuHide2
jsr crowTarget    // a free pumpkin?
bcc cuHide2
lda #180          // start at x 360 - off the right edge
sta CROW_X,x
lda CROW_TY,x     // 30 pixels above where it lands
sec
sbc #30
sta CROW_Y,x
lda #$01          // flying in
sta CROW_ST,x
cuHide2:
ldx CROW_I
cuHide:
lda $d015         // this crow's sprite off
and CROW_NBT,x
sta $d015
jmp cuNext

// state 1 - flying in: 2 px left and 1 px down/up a frame to its pumpkin
cuIn:
jsr crowGone      // pumpkin gone, or the player close - turn back
bcs cuToFlee
jsr crowNear
bcs cuToFlee
lda CROW_X,x      // across, until over the pumpkin
cmp CROW_TX,x
beq ciY
dec CROW_X,x
ciY:
lda CROW_Y,x      // down (or up), until level with it
cmp CROW_TY,x
beq ciLand
bcs ciUp
inc CROW_Y,x
jmp ciFrame
ciUp:
dec CROW_Y,x
jmp ciFrame
ciLand:
lda CROW_X,x      // there on both - land
cmp CROW_TX,x
bne ciFrame
lda #$02
sta CROW_ST,x
lda #$00          // pose clock and pecks start again
sta CROW_T,x
sta CROW_HIT,x
ciFrame:
lda CROW_ANI,x    // wing frame = clock / 4, 0-3
lsr
lsr
and #$03
tay
lda crowFlyL,y    // heading left
sta CROW_FR,x
lda crowBobT,y    // body bobs with the wings
sta CROW_BOB,x
jmp cuDraw
cuToFlee:
jsr crowFlee
jmp cuNext

// state 2 - on the pumpkin. crowLandT: a 64 frame cycle of looks and pecks;
// the end of each cycle is one peck hit, 4 hits break the pumpkin.
cuLand:
jsr crowGone      // pumpkin gone, or the player close - off
bcs cuToFlee
jsr crowNear
bcs cuToFlee
inc CROW_T,x      // pose clock
lda CROW_T,x
and #$3f          // end of a 64 frame cycle?
bne clPose
inc CROW_HIT,x    // a peck hit
lda CROW_HIT,x
cmp #$04
bcc clPose
jsr crowBreak     // 4 hits - broken, and away
jsr crowFlee
jmp cuNext
clPose:
lda CROW_T,x      // pose = clock / 4, 0-15
lsr
lsr
and #$0f
tay
lda crowLandT,y
sta CROW_FR,x
lda #$00          // standing - no bob
sta CROW_BOB,x
jmp cuDraw

// state 3 - flying off: 2 px right a frame, rising 1 px every other frame
cuAway:
lda CROW_X,x      // off the right edge (x 360) - gone
cmp #180
bcs caGone
inc CROW_X,x
lda CROW_ANI,x    // up on every other frame
and #$01
bne caFrame
lda CROW_Y,x      // off the top - gone
cmp #20
bcc caGone
dec CROW_Y,x
caFrame:
lda CROW_ANI,x    // wing frame = clock / 4, 0-3
lsr
lsr
and #$03
tay
lda crowFlyR,y    // heading right
sta CROW_FR,x
lda crowBobT,y
sta CROW_BOB,x
jmp cuDraw
caGone:
lda #$00          // away, and wait before coming back
sta CROW_ST,x
jsr crowWait
jmp cuHide

// draw crow X on sprite 2 + X: pointer, black, position (+ bob), 9th x bit, on
cuDraw:
lda CROW_FR,x     // slot -> sprite pointer
clc
adc #$a0
sta $63fa,x
lda #$00          // black
sta $d029,x
txa               // Y = crow * 2 for the $D004/$D005 x,y pairs
asl
tay
lda CROW_Y,x      // y plus the wing-beat bob
clc
adc CROW_BOB,x
sta $d005,y
lda CROW_X,x      // x = CROW_X * 2, bit 7 goes into carry = the 9th x bit
asl
sta $d004,y
lda $d010         // (lda keeps the carry)
bcs cdHi
and CROW_NBT,x    // x < 256
jmp cdMsb
cdHi:
ora CROW_BIT,x    // x 256+
cdMsb:
sta $d010
lda $d015         // sprite on
ora CROW_BIT,x
sta $d015
cuNext:
ldx CROW_I        // next crow
dex
bmi cuDone
jmp cuLoop
cuDone:
rts

// ---- animation tables ----  Player sprite set slots. Edit these to change
// the crows' animation (the frames themselves are in the sprite editor).
// Flying: 4 wing frames, a new one every 4 frames (a 16 frame wing beat):
// wings up, half up, down, half down.
crowFlyL:
.byte 13,14,15,16
crowFlyR:
.byte 17,18,19,20
// y offset for each wing frame: the body sits low with the wings up and lifts
// on the down stroke (254 = -2)
crowBobT:
.byte 2,0,254,0
// On the pumpkin: 16 poses, a new one every 4 frames (a 64 frame cycle):
// look left x4, look right x4, then peck / peck down alternating x8
crowLandT:
.byte 23,23,23,23,24,24,24,24,21,22,21,22,21,22,21,22

code:
// RAIN + PLAYER FRAMES
// Rain = up to 6 drops on hardware sprites 2-7, Player slot 4 (pointer $A4).
// Each drop falls 4px a frame and drifts left like the drop graphic, with its own
// x speed of 1, 2 or 3 (the graphic's slope of 2, +/- 1 at random). A drop that
// reaches the split (y 182+, so it never shows in the text rows) or runs off the
// left edge starts again at the top somewhere new.
// Each day (and the first) has a 1 in 10 chance of rain, for the whole day
// (rainNewDay) - never once the ultimate scarecrow is up. No crows come while it rains - sprites 2-4 are theirs on dry
// days (CROWS block). While it rains every pumpkin is watered for free (rainWater)
// and voice 3 plays a soft constant rain hiss (rainSoundOn / rainSoundOff).
// Player frames - pointer = $A0 + slot.  Sprite 1 = MC body ($63F9), sprite 0 =
// hi-res outline ($63F8).  Body slot / outline slot (always body + 1):
//          stand   walk   pick
//   right   0/1    9/10    2/3
//   left    5/6   11/12    7/8
// While a direction is held the player swaps stand <-> walk every 8 frames and
// every other swap (onto the walk frame) is a footstep (sndStep, PV_SFX STEP).
// Idle = stand frame, silent.
RAIN_X   = $C400   // 6 x low bytes
RAIN_XH  = $C406   // 6 x high bits (0/1)
RAIN_Y   = $C40C   // 6 y
RAIN_DX  = $C412   // 6 x speeds (subtracted each frame)
RAINING  = $C418   // 1 = raining
RAIN_MSB = $C419   // $D010 bits being built
POSE_T   = $C41A   // frames left on the pick pose
FACING   = $C41B   // 0 right, 1 left
WALK_T   = $C41C   // walk frame counter (swap on every 8th)
WALK_PH  = $C41D   // 0 = stand frame, 1 = walk frame

// ---- rainInit ----  once at start: scatter the drops, set up sprites 2-7
rainInit:
lda #$00
sta RAINING
sta SCARE_ON      // no scarecrow yet (SCARECROW block)
sta POSE_T
sta FACING
sta WALK_PH
lda #$07
sta WALK_T
ldx #$05
riLoop:
jsr rainSpawn
lda $d41b
and #$7f
clc
adc #50
sta RAIN_Y,x
lda #$a4
sta $63fa,x
lda #$0f
sta $d029,x
dex
bpl riLoop
lda $d01c
and #$03
sta $d01c
lda $d017
and #$03
sta $d017
lda $d01d
and #$03
sta $d01d
lda $d01b
and #$03
sta $d01b
rts

// ---- rainSpawn ----  IN X = drop.  New drop at the top, x 64..319. Y 48 puts the
// first pixel row (row 2) on raster 51, the first field line - any higher and
// it shows in the top border
rainSpawn:
lda $d41b
clc
adc #64
sta RAIN_X,x
lda #$00
adc #$00
sta RAIN_XH,x
lda #48
sta RAIN_Y,x
lda $d41b
and #$03
bne rsDx
lda #$02
rsDx:
sta RAIN_DX,x
rts

// ---- rainNewDay ----  at the start (init) and after fieldEndDay every day.
// Rain if the random byte is under 26 (26 / 256 = about 1 day in 10), for
// the whole day. Raise 26 for more rain (256 = every day, for testing).
rainNewDay:
lda SCARE_ON      // the ultimate scarecrow keeps the sky clear too
bne rainStop
lda $d41b
cmp #26
bcc rainStart
// ---- rainStop ----  a dry day: drops hidden by frameFx, hiss released
rainStop:
lda #$00
sta RAINING
jsr crowsReset
jmp rainSoundOff
// ---- rainStart ----  start the rain, its sound, and water everything
rainStart:
lda #$01
sta RAINING
jsr crowsReset    // no crows in the rain
jsr rainSprites   // sprites 2-4 may still be set up as crows
jsr rainSoundOn
jmp rainWater

// ---- rainSprites ----  sprites 2-7 back to raindrops (pointer $A4, colour 15)
rainSprites:
ldx #$05
rsLoop:
lda #$a4
sta $63fa,x
lda #$0f
sta $d029,x
dex
bpl rsLoop
rts

// ---- rain sound - voice 3 noise ----
// Voice 3 is ALSO the random number source ($D41B reads its noise). Its
// frequency ($FFFF) and noise waveform are never touched - only the gate - so
// $D41B stays random whether it rains or not. Footsteps / pluck are voice 1.
// The rain is not filtered: the SID's one filter belongs to the footsteps
// (sndStep routes voice 1 through a low cutoff, sndPluck takes it out).
rainSoundOn:
lda #$a0        // attack 10 (fades in ~0.5s), decay 0
sta $d413
lda #$49        // sustain 4 (soft, under the effects), release 9 (~0.75s)
sta $d414
lda #$81        // noise + gate on - holds at the sustain level while it rains
sta $d412
rts
rainSoundOff:
lda #$80        // noise, gate off - the hiss releases, $D41B keeps running
sta $d412
rts

// ---- rainWater ----  every pumpkin (kind 1-7) watered + redrawn wet
rainWater:
ldx #$00
rwLoop:
stx UV_PUMPIDX
lda PUMPKINS,x
cmp #$ff
beq rwDone
cmp #$fe
beq rwNext
lda PUMPKINS+2,x
beq rwNext
bmi rwNext
lda PUMPKINS+3,x
bne rwNext
lda #$01
sta PUMPKINS+3,x
jsr drawRecord
rwNext:
ldx UV_PUMPIDX
inx
inx
inx
inx
bne rwLoop
rwDone:
rts

// ---- frameFx ----  every frame from the main loop: pick pose, walk, rain
frameFx:
lda POSE_T
beq ffWalk
dec POSE_T
bne ffWalk
jsr playerFrame
// walk - joystick port 2 read straight from $DC00 (bits 0-3 low = held).
// NOT $F8: the KEYS MISC macro zeroes $F6-$F9 after the JOYSTICK macro, so
// by now $F8 always reads as every direction held. KEYS MISC leaves $DC00 =
// $7F (keyboard column), which keeps bits 0-3 for the stick.
ffWalk:
lda $dc00
and #$0f
cmp #$0f
bne wkMove
// idle - back to the stand frame; WALK_T = 7 so the next move steps at once
lda #$07
sta WALK_T
lda WALK_PH
beq ffRain
lda #$00
sta WALK_PH
jsr playerFrame
jmp ffRain
wkMove:
inc WALK_T
lda WALK_T
and #$07
bne ffRain
lda WALK_PH
eor #$01
sta WALK_PH
jsr playerFrame
// footstep on every other swap (onto the walk frame) = every 16 frames
lda WALK_PH
beq ffRain
jsr sndStep
ffRain:
lda RAINING
bne ruOn
jmp crowUpdate  // dry: sprites 2-4 are the crows (CROWS block)
ruOn:
ldx #$05
ruLoop:
lda RAIN_Y,x
clc
adc #$04
sta RAIN_Y,x
cmp #182
bcs ruNew
lda RAIN_X,x
sec
sbc RAIN_DX,x
sta RAIN_X,x
bcs ruNext
lda RAIN_XH,x
beq ruNew
lda #$00
sta RAIN_XH,x
jmp ruNext
ruNew:
jsr rainSpawn
ruNext:
dex
bpl ruLoop
// drop n -> sprite n+2 at $D004 + 2n, x high bits gathered into RAIN_MSB
lda #$00
sta RAIN_MSB
ldx #$05
ldy #$0a
ruVic:
lda RAIN_X,x
sta $d004,y
lda RAIN_Y,x
sta $d005,y
lda RAIN_XH,x
lsr
rol RAIN_MSB
dey
dey
dex
bpl ruVic
asl RAIN_MSB
asl RAIN_MSB
lda $d010
and #$03
ora RAIN_MSB
sta $d010
lda $d015
ora #$fc
sta $d015
rts

// ---- setFacing ----  IN A = 0 right / 1 left  (from the LF / RT handlers)
setFacing:
sta FACING
// ---- playerFrame ----  point sprites 0/1 at the right frames (table above)
playerFrame:
lda POSE_T
bne pfPick
lda WALK_PH
bne pfWalk
ldy #$00
lda FACING
beq pfSet
ldy #$05
jmp pfSet
pfPick:
ldy #$02
lda FACING
beq pfSet
ldy #$07
jmp pfSet
pfWalk:
ldy #$09
lda FACING
beq pfSet
ldy #$0b
pfSet:
tya
clc
adc #$a0
sta $63f9
adc #$01
sta $63f8
rts

// ---- pickPose ----  bend down for 15 frames after FIRE
pickPose:
lda #15
sta POSE_T
jmp playerFrame

PUMPKINS list, 4 bytes each
 col, row, kind, watered
 kind 0 seed, 1-7 pumpkin
 growth (7 = ready),
 $80/$81 weed A/B
 col $FE = free slot
drawRecord / drawGround /

nodes.title: SCARECROW
code:
// SCARECROW - the end goal (see the GAME PLAN comment)
// The ultimate scarecrow: once it stands in the field no crow ever comes
// again, the sky stays dry, and walking up to it ends the game (gameEnd).
// For now it is summoned by a cheat: hold S + C together on the field.
// It is hardware sprite 2 (the first crow's), expanded 2x both ways, Player
// sprite set slot 25 (pointer $B9), yellow.
SCARE_ON = $C46A   // 1 = the scarecrow is up (zeroed by rainInit)
SCARE_X  = $C46B   // x / 2 (half pixels, like the crows)
SCARE_Y  = $C46C   // y

// ---- scareKeys ----  every frame from the main loop. S + C = the scarecrow.
// Keyboard read straight from the CIA: $DC00 picks a row, $DC01 bits low = held.
// S = row 1 ($FD) column 5 ($20), C = row 2 ($FB) column 4 ($10).
// $DC00 goes back to $7F after, where the joystick code expects it.
scareKeys:
lda SCARE_ON      // already up - nothing to do
bne skDone
lda #$fd          // keyboard row 1 ...
sta $dc00
lda $dc01
and #$20          // ... column 5 = S held?
bne skOff
lda #$fb          // keyboard row 2 ...
sta $dc00
lda $dc01
and #$10          // ... column 4 = C held?
bne skOff
lda #$7f          // both - keyboard back for the joystick
sta $dc00
lda #$01          // the scarecrow is up
sta SCARE_ON
lda RAINING
beq skPlace
jsr rainStop      // the scarecrow clears the sky as well
// on the far side of the field from the player, so it is a walk to get to it
skPlace:
lda $d41b         // random y 70-133
and #$3f
clc
adc #70
sta SCARE_Y
lda $d010         // player x / 2 (9th bit from $D010 bit 0 via carry)
lsr
lda $d000
ror
cmp #90           // player on the left half (x < 180)?
bcc skRight
lda $d41b         // player on the right - scarecrow x 40-102
and #$1f
clc
adc #20
jmp skX
skRight:
lda $d41b         // player on the left - x 232-294 (48 wide, so it stays
and #$1f          // inside the right border)
clc
adc #116
skX:
sta SCARE_X
rts
skOff:
lda #$7f          // not both held - keyboard back for the joystick
sta $dc00
skDone:
rts

// ---- scareUpdate ----  from crowUpdate (dry frames) once SCARE_ON is set,
// instead of the crows. CROW_PX / CROW_PY already hold the player position.
scareUpdate:
lda $d015
and #$e7          // sprites 3-4 (crows 2 and 3) gone for good
sta $d015
lda #$b9          // sprite 2 = Player slot 25, the scarecrow
sta $63fa
lda #$07          // yellow
sta $d029
lda $d017         // sprite 2 double height ...
ora #$04
sta $d017
lda $d01d         // ... and double width
ora #$04
sta $d01d
lda SCARE_X       // x = SCARE_X * 2, bit 7 into carry = the 9th x bit
asl
sta $d004
lda $d010         // (lda keeps the carry)
bcs suHi
and #$fb          // x < 256
jmp suMsb
suHi:
ora #$04          // x 256+
suMsb:
sta $d010
lda SCARE_Y
sta $d005
lda $d015         // sprite 2 on
ora #$04
sta $d015
// reached it? Centres: scarecrow x/2 + 12, y + 21 (48 x 42 expanded),
// player x/2 + 6, y + 10
lda SCARE_X       // |scarecrow centre - player centre| across
clc
adc #6
sec
sbc CROW_PX
bcs suAx
eor #$ff          // negative - flip it
adc #$01
suAx:
cmp #20           // 40 pixels across
bcs suNo
lda SCARE_Y       // |scarecrow centre - player centre| down
clc
adc #11
sec
sbc CROW_PY
bcs suAy
eor #$ff
adc #$01
suAy:
cmp #26           // 26 pixels down
bcs suNo
jmp gameEnd       // there - THE END (never comes back)
suNo:
rts

nodes.title: STEP FILTER ON
code:
// footsteps are muted through the SID low-pass: voice 1 into the filter,
// low cutoff, no resonance. sndPluck takes voice 1 back out; nothing else
// (rain on voice 3) goes through the filter.
lda #$00
sta $d415       // cutoff low bits
lda #$10        // cutoff high - low = muted, raise for a brighter step
sta $d416
lda #$01        // filter voice 1 only, resonance 0
sta $d417
lda #$1f        // low-pass mode, volume 15
sta $d418

nodes.title: Code Block
END SCREEN ON
code:
// THE END - set up before the VIC node switches to the ENDING_SCR text screen
// ($3400). PLACEHOLDER for a proper end bitmap: PETSCII scarecrow + text.
// Raster IRQs off for good (their VIC writes would switch back to the game),
// sprites off, all sound stopped, colour RAM coloured a row at a time from
// endRowCol. The game never comes back from here.
lda #$00          // raster IRQs off
sta $d01a
lda #$ff          // and any pending one acknowledged
sta $d019
lda #$00
sta $d015         // sprites off
sta $d020         // black border ...
sta $d021         // ... and background
sta $d404         // voice 1 (footsteps / pluck) off
sta $d40b         // voice 2 off
sta $d417         // no filter
lda #$80          // voice 3: noise, gate off - $D41B stays random
sta $d412
lda #$0f          // full volume for the end music
sta $d418
// colour RAM, 25 rows of 40, each row one colour from endRowCol
lda #$00          // ($FB) = $D800, the start of colour RAM
sta $fb
lda #$d8
sta $fc
ldx #$00          // row 0-24
esRow:
lda endRowCol,x   // this row's colour ...
ldy #39
esCol:
sta ($fb),y       // ... across all 40 columns
dey
bpl esCol
lda $fb           // ($FB) down a row (+40)
clc
adc #40
sta $fb
bcc esNext
inc $fc
esNext:
inx
cpx #25
bne esRow
jmp esDone        // over the table
// one colour per screen row (matches the art in ENDING_SCR):
// title yellow, hat brown, face yellow, coat orange, pole brown,
// message white, THE END orange, placeholder note grey
endRowCol:
.byte 0,7,0,9,9,9,7,7,7,7,8,8,8,8,9,9,9,0,1,1,0,8,0,12,0
esDone:

nodes.title: Code Block
code:
// CLOCK DISPLAY
// UV_HOUR is 24h (7 = 7AM ... 19 = 7PM).  Converts to 12h BCD in
// UV_HOURDISP for the PRINT EXT node, and writes AM / PM straight into
// the text row at $0400 + 21*40 + 10  (right after the two hour digits)
clockDisp:
lda UV_HOUR
ldx #$01
cmp #12
bcc cdAm
ldx #$10
cmp #13
bcc cdAm
sec
sbc #12
cdAm:
stx $0752
cmp #10
bcc cdBcd
clc
adc #$06
cdBcd:
sta UV_HOURDISP
lda #$0d
sta $0753
lda #$01
sta $db52
sta $db53
rts

nodes.title: Code Block
code:
// FIRE + HOME LATCH RELEASE
// $F8 = joystick state latched by the JOYSTICK macro above
// bit 4 low = fire held, so only release the fire latch once fire is up
lda $F8
and #$10
beq flHeld
lda #$00
sta UV_FIRELATCH
flHeld:
// bits 0-3 all high = no direction held - release the home latch so the
// house can end another day (stops a held UP chaining days at the door)
lda $F8
and #$0f
cmp #$0f
bne hlHeld
lda #$00
sta UV_HOMELATCH
hlHeld:
// DOUBLE-TAP TIMER for planting - the first FIRE on a plantable spot loads 50
// (1 second) into UV_FIRETIMER, see faPlant. Count it down once per frame.
lda UV_FIRETIMER
beq ftDone
dec UV_FIRETIMER
ftDone:

nodes.title: Code Block
code:
// FIELD DRAW ROUTINES
// PUMPKINS asset = records of  col, row, kind, watered  (4 bytes)
//   col $FE = free slot, col $FF = end of list
//   kind  0      = seed            (tile 5, 1 char, tag 7)
//   kind  1..7   = pumpkin growth  (2 chars, phase = (growth+1)/2, tag phase+1, 7 = ready)
//   kind  $80/81 = weed A / B      (tile 4 / 6, 1 char, tag 6)
//   watered 0/1  - pumpkins draw from source row 1 (the wet pictures) while watered
// Source sheet - row 0 = dirt, dirt, picked, stage1..4 dry   row 1 = weedA, seed, weedB, stage1..4 wet
PUMPKINS = $C300

// ---- drawRecord ----  IN  X = record offset.  Never draws on rows 0-1 (the source sheet)
drawRecord:
stx UV_PUMPIDX
lda PUMPKINS+1,x
cmp #$02
bcc drSkip
sta UV_GOT_ROW
lda PUMPKINS,x
sta UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda PUMPKINS+2,x
bmi drWeed
beq drSeed
clc
adc #$01
lsr
sta UV_PUMPSTATE
asl
clc
adc #$01
sta UV_SRC_X
lda PUMPKINS+3,x
sta UV_SRC_Y
lda UV_PUMPSTATE
clc
adc #$01
sta UV_PUMPTAG
lda UV_GOT_COLUMN
clc
adc #$01
sta UV_GOT_COLUMN2
jmp tileUpdate
drSeed:
lda #$01
sta UV_SRC_X
sta UV_SRC_Y
lda #$07
sta UV_PUMPTAG
jmp tileUpdate1
drWeed:
and #$01
asl
sta UV_SRC_X
lda #$01
sta UV_SRC_Y
lda #$06
sta UV_PUMPTAG
jmp tileUpdate1
drSkip:
rts

// ---- drawGround ----  IN  A = source col (0 = dirt, 2 = picked), UV_GOT_COLUMN / UV_GOT_ROW
drawGround:
sta UV_SRC_X
lda #$00
sta UV_SRC_Y
lda #$08
sta UV_PUMPTAG
jmp tileUpdate1

// ---- drawAll ----  every live record (called from init)
drawAll:
ldx #$00
daLoop:
stx UV_PUMPIDX
lda PUMPKINS,x
cmp #$ff
beq daDone
cmp #$fe
beq daNext
jsr drawRecord
daNext:
ldx UV_PUMPIDX
inx
inx
inx
inx
bne daLoop
daDone:
rts

// ---- tileAddr ----  $FB/$FC = $0400 + UV_GOT_ROW*40 + UV_GOT_COLUMN  (the collision tag of that char)
tileAddr:
lda UV_GOT_ROW
sta $fb
lda #$00
sta $fc
asl $fb
rol $fc
asl $fb
rol $fc
asl $fb
rol $fc
lda $fb
sta $fd
lda $fc
sta $fe
asl $fb
rol $fc
asl $fb
rol $fc
clc
lda $fb
adc $fd
sta $fb
lda $fc
adc $fe
sta $fc
clc
lda $fb
adc UV_GOT_COLUMN
sta $fb
lda $fc
adc #$04
sta $fc
rts

// ---- findRecord ----  IN UV_GOT_COLUMN / UV_GOT_ROW (either half of a pumpkin)
// OUT carry set + X = record, carry clear = nothing there
findRecord:
ldx #$00
frLoop:
lda PUMPKINS,x
cmp #$ff
beq frMiss
cmp #$fe
beq frNext
cmp UV_GOT_COLUMN
beq frRow
ldy PUMPKINS+2,x
beq frNext
bmi frNext
clc
adc #$01
cmp UV_GOT_COLUMN
bne frNext
frRow:
lda PUMPKINS+1,x
cmp UV_GOT_ROW
beq frHit
frNext:
inx
inx
inx
inx
bne frLoop
frMiss:
clc
rts
frHit:
stx UV_PUMPIDX
sec
rts

// ---- freeRecord ----  OUT carry set + X = a free slot, carry clear = list full
freeRecord:
ldx #$00
fzLoop:
lda PUMPKINS,x
cmp #$fe
beq fzHit
cmp #$ff
beq fzMiss
inx
inx
inx
inx
bne fzLoop
fzMiss:
clc
rts
fzHit:
sec
rts

nodes.title: NEXT DAY ON
code:
// NEXT DAY summary screen - set up before the VIC node switches to it
// Raster IRQs off: their VIC writes would switch straight back to the game.
// Sprites off: in bank 0 their pointers ($33F8) are not set up.
// Colour RAM is shared with the bitmap's MC colours, so rows 7-17 ($D918,
// 440 bytes) go to the NIGHT_CRAM asset and come back after.
// Today's counts (BCD) go into the NEXTDAY_SCR text at col 18-19, rows 10-13.
NIGHT_CRAM = $C500   // NIGHT_CRAM asset, 440 bytes
NIGHT_SPR  = $C428   // saved $D015
DAY_PLANT  = $C430   // today's counts, BCD - counted in fireAction,
DAY_WATER  = $C431   // zeroed at start and after this screen
DAY_PLUCK  = $C432
DAY_WEED   = $C433
lda #$00
sta $d01a
lda #$ff
sta $d019
lda $d015
sta NIGHT_SPR
lda #$00
sta $d015
// save colour RAM rows 7-17 in two halves of 220, set the text white
ldx #$00
ndSave:
lda $d918,x
sta NIGHT_CRAM,x
lda $d9f4,x
sta NIGHT_CRAM+220,x
lda #$01
sta $d918,x
sta $d9f4,x
inx
cpx #220
bne ndSave
// title row 7 yellow, PRESS FIRE row 17 light green
ldx #39
ndColour:
lda #$07
sta $d918,x
lda #$0d
sta $daa8,x
dex
bpl ndColour
// the four counts, two BCD digits each
lda DAY_PLANT
lsr
lsr
lsr
lsr
ora #$30
sta $31a2
lda DAY_PLANT
and #$0f
ora #$30
sta $31a3
lda DAY_WATER
lsr
lsr
lsr
lsr
ora #$30
sta $31ca
lda DAY_WATER
and #$0f
ora #$30
sta $31cb
lda DAY_PLUCK
lsr
lsr
lsr
lsr
ora #$30
sta $31f2
lda DAY_PLUCK
and #$0f
ora #$30
sta $31f3
lda DAY_WEED
lsr
lsr
lsr
lsr
ora #$30
sta $321a
lda DAY_WEED
and #$0f
ora #$30
sta $321b

nodes.title: END MUSIC
code:
// END MUSIC - PLACEHOLDER victory jig until the real tune goes in (a DATA_SID
// / SID SONG node can replace this). 32 steps of 10 frames, looped forever:
// voice 1 pulse melody, voice 2 triangle bass. Timed off raster line 250 as
// the IRQs are off. Note tables are PAL frequencies; 0 = rest / let it ring.
END_STEP = $C46D   // step 0-31
END_T    = $C46E   // frames left on this step
lda #$00
sta END_STEP      // from the top
sta $d402         // pulse width low
lda #$08          // pulse width $0800 (50%)
sta $d403
lda #$09          // melody: attack 0, decay 9, no sustain - plucky
sta $d405
lda #$00          // sustain 0, release 0
sta $d406
lda #$0a          // bass: attack 0, decay 10
sta $d40c
lda #$00          // sustain 0, release 0
sta $d40d
emStep:
ldx END_STEP
lda emHi,x        // melody note - 0 = rest
beq emRest
sta $d401         // voice 1 frequency
lda emLo,x
sta $d400
lda #$40          // pulse, gate off then on = a new note
sta $d404
lda #$41
sta $d404
jmp emBass
emRest:
lda #$40          // rest - gate off, the note dies away
sta $d404
emBass:
lda ebHi,x        // bass note - 0 = let the last one ring
beq emWait
sta $d408         // voice 2 frequency
lda ebLo,x
sta $d407
lda #$10          // triangle, gate off then on = a new note
sta $d40b
lda #$11
sta $d40b
emWait:
lda #10           // hold this step for 10 frames
sta END_T
emFrame:
lda $d012         // wait for raster line 250 ...
cmp #250
bne emFrame
emLine:
lda $d012         // ... and for it to pass = one frame
cmp #250
beq emLine
dec END_T
bne emFrame
lda END_STEP      // next step, 31 wraps to 0
clc
adc #$01
and #$1f
sta END_STEP
jmp emStep

// melody  A4 C5 E5 A5 G5 E5 C5 E5 | F5 E5 D5 C5 B4 C5 D5 E5 |
//         A4 C5 E5 A5 G5 E5 C5 E5 | F5 D5 B4 G4 A4 -  A4 -
emLo:
.byte 69,206,218,137,38,218,206,218,118,218,17,206,218,206,17,218,69,206,218,137,38,218,206,218,118,17,218,19,69,0,69,0
emHi:
.byte 29,34,43,58,52,43,34,43,46,43,39,34,32,34,39,43,29,34,43,58,52,43,34,43,46,39,32,26,29,0,29,0
// bass    A2 E3 A2 E3 | F2 C3 G2 B2 | A2 E3 A2 E3 | F2 G2 A2 A2  (every other step)
ebLo:
.byte 81,0,246,0,81,0,246,0,207,0,179,0,133,0,54,0,81,0,246,0,81,0,246,0,207,0,133,0,81,0,81,0
ebHi:
.byte 7,0,10,0,7,0,10,0,5,0,8,0,6,0,8,0,7,0,10,0,7,0,10,0,5,0,6,0,7,0,7,0

nodes.title: Code Block
code:
// CLOCK TICK  (runs every frame)
// 50 frames = 1 second, 250 frames = half an hour, 2 halves = 1 hour
// so 10 seconds of play = 1 game hour.  8PM = end of the day.
inc UV_FRAME
lda UV_FRAME
cmp #250
bne ckDone
lda #$00
sta UV_FRAME
inc UV_HALF
lda UV_HALF
cmp #$02
bne ckDone
lda #$00
sta UV_HALF
inc UV_HOUR
lda UV_HOUR
cmp #20
bne ckShow
lda #$01
sta UV_ENDDAY
jmp ckDone
ckShow:

nodes.title: Code Block
code:
// FIRE ON THE FIELD  (called by FR after collisionCheck)
// UV_PLANTTYPE = tag of the probed char, UV_GOT_COLUMN / UV_GOT_ROW = where
//   2..5 pumpkin  - ready (growth 7) = pick it (PLUCK sound), otherwise water it
//   6    weed     - stomp it (back to dirt tile 1)
//   7    seed     - nothing (seeds sprout on their own after 1-2 days)
//   0/8  grass or dirt - plant a seed (costs 1 of UV_SEEDS, rows 2-18, the char to the
//                  right must be grass/dirt too, and no seed directly to the left).
//                  Needs a DOUBLE TAP - the first FIRE arms the spot for 1 second
//                  (UV_FIRETIMER, counted down every frame in the main loop), a
//                  second FIRE on the same spot inside that second plants it.
// Each action also counts up today's DAY_PLANT / DAY_WATER / DAY_PLUCK /
// DAY_WEED (BCD) for the NEXT DAY summary. Watering only counts a dry pumpkin.
fireAction:
lda UV_GOT_ROW
cmp #$02
bcc faDone
lda UV_PLANTTYPE
cmp #$08
beq faPlantJ
cmp #$00
bne faNotPlant
faPlantJ:
jmp faPlant     // too far for a branch
faNotPlant:
cmp #$06
beq faStomp
cmp #$02
bcc faDone
cmp #$06
bcs faDone
jsr findRecord
bcc faDone
lda PUMPKINS+2,x
cmp #$07
bcs faPick
faWet:
lda PUMPKINS+3,x
bne faWetAgain
sed
clc
lda DAY_WATER
adc #$01
sta DAY_WATER
cld
faWetAgain:
lda #$01
sta PUMPKINS+3,x
jmp drawRecord
faDone:
rts

faPick:
jsr sndPluck    // PV_SFX PLUCK - only uses A, X still = the record
sed
clc
lda UV_PUMPCOUNT
adc #$01
sta UV_PUMPCOUNT
clc
lda DAY_PLUCK
adc #$01
sta DAY_PLUCK
cld
lda PUMPKINS,x
sta UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda PUMPKINS+1,x
sta UV_GOT_ROW
lda #$fe
sta PUMPKINS,x
lda #$02
jsr drawGround
inc UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda #$02
jmp drawGround

faStomp:
jsr findRecord
bcc faDone
sed
clc
lda DAY_WEED
adc #$01
sta DAY_WEED
cld
lda #$fe
sta PUMPKINS,x
lda #$00
jmp drawGround

// planting returns through its own rts - faDone is out of branch range
faPlantNo:
rts
faPlant:
lda UV_SEEDS
beq faPlantNo
lda UV_GOT_ROW
cmp #19
bcs faPlantNo
lda UV_GOT_COLUMN
cmp #39
bcs faPlantNo
jsr tileAddr
ldy #$01
lda ($fb),y
beq faPlantR
cmp #$08
bne faPlantNo
faPlantR:
lda UV_GOT_COLUMN
beq faPlantOk
lda $fb
bne faPlantDec
dec $fc
faPlantDec:
dec $fb
ldy #$00
lda ($fb),y
cmp #$07
beq faPlantNo
faPlantOk:
// double tap - timer still running AND same spot as the first press = plant
lda UV_FIRETIMER
beq faArm
lda UV_ARMCOL
cmp UV_GOT_COLUMN
bne faArm
lda UV_ARMROW
cmp UV_GOT_ROW
bne faArm
lda #$00
sta UV_FIRETIMER
jsr freeRecord
bcs faPlantGo
rts
faPlantGo:
sed
sec

nodes.title: Code Block
PRESS FIRE
code:
// PRESS FIRE FOR THE NEXT DAY - joystick port 2 fire = $DC00 bit 4 low.
// Wait for fire up first (it may still be held), then a press, then the
// release - so the press can't also plant / water / pick in the field.
// (The kernal key scan always leaves $DC00 = $7F, and it is off under SEI.)
// This ends on any raster line - NEXT DAY OFF clears raster bit 8 for that.
ndFireUp:
lda $dc00
and #$10
beq ndFireUp
ndFireDown:
lda $dc00
and #$10
bne ndFireDown
ndFireUp2:
lda $dc00
and #$10
beq ndFireUp2

nodes.title: Code Block
code:
// END OF DAY ON THE FIELD  (called after the blink)
// seeds sprout into saplings when their day count runs out (1-2 days, no water
// needed), watered pumpkins grow one step and dry out, then 1-4 weeds sprout on the
// grass (tag 0) anywhere in rows 2-18 - never on the dirt patch. Stomping one
// turns that spot into dirt tile 1, which can then be planted.
fieldEndDay:
ldx #$00
edLoop:
stx UV_PUMPIDX
lda PUMPKINS,x
cmp #$ff
bne edLive
jmp edWeeds
edLive:
cmp #$fe
beq edNext
lda PUMPKINS+2,x
bmi edNext
bne edPumpkin
// ---- seed - byte 3 counts the days down, then it sprouts by itself ----
lda PUMPKINS+3,x
beq edSprout
dec PUMPKINS+3,x
bne edNext
edSprout:
lda PUMPKINS,x
sta UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda PUMPKINS+1,x
sta UV_GOT_ROW
jsr tileAddr
ldy #$01
lda ($fb),y
beq edSproutOk
cmp #$08
beq edSproutOk
cmp #$07
bne edNext
// a seed on the right gets swallowed by the new sapling
stx UV_TRIES
inc UV_GOT_COLUMN
jsr findRecord
bcc edSproutBack
lda #$fe
sta PUMPKINS,x
edSproutBack:
dec UV_GOT_COLUMN
ldx UV_TRIES
stx UV_PUMPIDX
edSproutOk:
ldx UV_PUMPIDX
lda #$01
sta PUMPKINS+2,x
lda #$00
sta PUMPKINS+3,x
jsr drawRecord
jmp edNext
// ---- pumpkin - only grows if it was watered today ----
edPumpkin:
lda PUMPKINS+3,x
beq edNext
lda #$00
sta PUMPKINS+3,x
lda PUMPKINS+2,x
cmp #$07
bcs edDraw
clc
adc #$01
sta PUMPKINS+2,x
edDraw:
jsr drawRecord
edNext:
ldx UV_PUMPIDX
inx
inx
inx
inx
beq edWeeds
jmp edLoop

// ---- weeds ----  SID voice 3 noise at $D41B is the random source
edWeeds:
lda $d41b
and #$03
clc
adc #$01
sta UV_WEEDN
edWeedLoop:
lda #$20
sta UV_TRIES
edTry:
lda $d41b
and #$3f
cmp #40
bcs edTryAgain
sta UV_GOT_COLUMN
lda $d41b
and #$1f
cmp #$02
bcc edTryAgain
cmp #19
bcs edTryAgain
sta UV_GOT_ROW
jsr tileAddr
ldy #$00
lda ($fb),y
bne edTryAgain
jsr freeRecord
bcc edWeedsDone
lda UV_GOT_COLUMN
sta PUMPKINS,x
lda UV_GOT_ROW
sta PUMPKINS+1,x
lda $d41b
and #$01
ora #$80
sta PUMPKINS+2,x
lda #$00
sta PUMPKINS+3,x
jsr drawRecord
jmp edWeedNext
edTryAgain:
dec UV_TRIES
bne edTry
edWeedNext:
dec UV_WEEDN
bne edWeedLoop
edWeedsDone:
rts

nodes.title: NEXT DAY OFF
code:
// NEXT DAY screen - put the game back (display is off)
// Colour RAM + sprites restored, today's counts zeroed for the new day, raster
// IRQs acked and back on. After the CLI below the BitmapMode / TextMode IRQs
// switch the VIC back to the game split and turn the display on again.
// RASTER BIT 8: the DISPLAY node does lda/and/sta $D011, and reading $D011
// gives the CURRENT raster's bit 8. After PRESS FIRE that can run on a line
// 256+, which writes bit 8 into the IRQ compare - 203 becomes 459, a line PAL
// never reaches, so the IRQs stop and the VIC stays on this text screen.
// Clear it here, before the CLI.
ldx #$00
ndRest:
lda NIGHT_CRAM,x
sta $d918,x
lda NIGHT_CRAM+220,x
sta $d9f4,x
inx
cpx #220
bne ndRest
lda NIGHT_SPR
sta $d015
lda #$00
sta DAY_PLANT
sta DAY_WATER
sta DAY_PLUCK
sta DAY_WEED
lda $d011
and #$7f
sta $d011
lda #$ff
sta $d019
lda #$01
sta $d01a
